test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

He did not forgot / to consult his parents / before accepting / the job offer.
solution: The correct answer is **'He did not forgot'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'He did not forget' **should be used instead of **'He did not forgot'.** • We know that the helping verb '**did**' is always followed by **the base form** of the **verb i.e. "forget" in the given context**. • *Example: I **didn't know** how to answer his question.* **Correct Sentence:__** ***He did not forget** to consult his parents before accepting the job offer.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ, '**He did not forgot**' के स्थान पर '**He did not forget**' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • हम जानते हैं कि सहायक क्रिया '**did**' के बाद **verb** का** base form** हमेशा आता है। • *Example: I **didn't know **how to answer his question.* a2:Tec4, The correct answer is '**for**'.
